findings.finding: List-valued statuses still crashed late validation passes.
findings.repair: Normalized status values before every membership check and added malformed status and Clay-alternative regressions.

findings.finding: Target subject hashes omitted proof, evidence, and counterexample bytes.
findings.repair: Included SHA-256 digests of every resolved dependency-closure artifact in the subject hash.

findings.finding: Unknown or decision finding dispositions passed converged review validation.
findings.repair: Closed convergence dispositions to invalid, hallucinated, and duplicate; required reasons and fingerprints.

findings.finding: Raw-path comparison allowed one physical file to occupy internal and external roles.
findings.repair: Resolved paths, enforced role directories, uniqueness, and cross-role disjointness.

findings.finding: Certification could truncate or hollow out gauntlet history.
findings.repair: Bound filenames to round IDs, validated every node's minimum schema, required contiguous hashes and latest same-target head, and checked duplicate fingerprints chronologically.

findings.finding: Analytic claims could hide unbridged computations transitively.
findings.repair: Required a proved non-computation bridge mapping for every transitive computation dependency of every settled analytic claim.

findings.finding: Refuted claims could depend on blocked premises.
findings.repair: Applied dependency settlement to established, proved, and refuted owners.

findings.finding: Canonical Clay IDs could name a different alternative.
findings.repair: Required exact CLAY-A through CLAY-D ID/alternative matching.

findings.finding: Rootless direct API validation could report success without checking artifacts.
findings.repair: Full validation now requires a root; structural-only callers must opt in explicitly.

findings.finding: Duplicate JSON member names were silently accepted by last-value wins parsing.
findings.repair: Added duplicate-rejecting JSON parsing for ledgers and reviews.

findings.finding: Missing or ambiguous Markdown claim statuses disabled synchronization.
findings.repair: Normalized formatting and rejected every claim row with zero or multiple statuses.

findings.finding: A deep acyclic claim graph caused recursive cycle detection to overflow.
findings.repair: Replaced recursion with iterative tri-color DFS and passed a 1,100-node regression.

findings.finding: Punctuation-only headings produced an empty internal anchor.
Local model and reviewer identity strings remain self-attested.
findings.reason: Authenticity requires an external signed, human-controlled trust root; the local validator documents but cannot create it.

findings.finding: Arbitrary prose may be semantically equivalent to a Clay target without structured declaration.
findings.reason: Generic explicit claims are canonicalized, but semantic equivalence is a mathematical-review obligation.

findings.finding: The project remains untracked and therefore lacks Git-backed durability.
findings.reason: No staging or commit was requested.

validation: deep acyclic dependency chain of 1,100 claims
unresolved_valid_findings: Version-control durability requires explicit user authorization to stage and commit this untracked project.
